active_reference.interpretation: The81 edges include supplier/type/route conditional parameterization links. Source sample_batch144-160 and paper AppendixC/D1 explicitly distinguish that layer;difference is not automatically a software bug. Current execution has not closed every conditional mechanism/nonedge for a single observational GT. No global F1/SHD produced.
active_reference.do_action_original_equation_checks: 301 recorded mismatches compare the intentionally replaced original Force equation;not used as post-do physics failures. Fixed-action values and actual mutilated-term snapshots are separate checks.
active_reference.trace_instrumentation: Pass-through observers;graph snapshot NodeModel memory-address strings are not reproducibility fingerprints. Topology/typed edges were compared independently.

observation_contract.interpretation: A do constant alone is not failure. Use baseline V* with full-column alignment and baseline reference semantics;if permitted by a future contract,not per-arm changing MAG/ADMG. No reference edited here.
observation_contract.force_units: Not encoded in returned graph metadata;kept as model-native numeric force,not certified actuator/safety units.

hard_do.cause: FCM.intervene_on fcm.py564-566 iterates in_edges tuples as old and constructs ((parent,target),target),so remove_edges_from silently misses actual(parent,target) edges.
hard_do.scope: Observed in self.mutilated_dags,not confused with returned baseline reference DAG. Constant replacement still yields numeric samples;this defect alone does not prove numeric do means wrong.
hard_do.after_discovery: Stopped ongoing second arm and all remaining repeats;upstream source not patched. Final runner adds a fail-closed snapshot check,unit-fixture tested only;no external rerun to make it pass.

quality_and_identification.quality_code: Threshold flags1 if within modeled limits;ProcessResult is product/AND of8 flags,1=conforming. Confirmed symbolic terms and paperD1;not plant certification.
quality_and_identification.conditional_loss: E[1-Y] is quality nonconformance probability for that coding. No estimated policy loss/ATE/ranking produced here.
quality_and_identification.action30000: Outside generated empirical range;not proof of mathematical zero support. Tail/positivity/extrapolation remains a barrier.

identification.scope: Generic nonparametric ADMG identification only,conditional on returned reference validity;not proof for an additionally restricted known-function model. No effect estimator fit.

quality_and_identification.result: If returned ADMG is a valid reference,it contains the checked hedge;generic nonparametric observation-only P(Y|do(A)) is not identified. Additional known-physics/functional restrictions could change the question but are not assumed here.
quality_and_identification.nondegenerate_choice: NOT_ASSESSED;second arm incomplete,no models fit,no chosen-policy comparison.
quality_and_identification.physical_action_interpretation: Ideal hard-do on Force=MVlength*stiffness variable,not verified command/setpoint of a real force controller;no actuator-equivalence/safe-range claim.

seed_contract.interpretation: No overlapping effective seeds across these two calls,but within-call reuse means paths cannot be counted independent. Disjoint seed integers alone do not prove independent samples. Routing/parameters are fixed package objects across seeds.
seed_contract.fresh_object_intervention_state: Constructor verified empty dictionary for every executed fresh object;no object switched arms. Same-object carryover not tested.

resources.measurement_limits: Download figure is actual source/API payload+wheels;pip index/HTTP metadata overhead not fully metered. RSS is0.1s-polled sum of job-member per-process PeakWorkingSetSize,not an exact aggregate instantaneous peak;2GiB job commit cap is distinct from RSS.
